isolationMechanism.principle: Create ONE probe-owned null sink, point ONLY the probe's own Chromium child at it via that child's environment, and record that sink's OWN monitor. The system default sink is never changed, no other client is moved, and the default monitor (which would be a mixed capture of every application) is never recorded.
steps: 1. Create the owned sink (records the module id for exact teardown).

2. Launch the probe's Chromium with PULSE_SINK=paravoxia_finale_window in its environment ONLY. libpulse routes that client's streams to the named sink; the shell default and every other client are untouched.

3. Verify, before recording, that the sink-inputs on paravoxia_finale_window are exactly the probe's own browser process tree (application.process.id in the probe child's descendants) and that no other client is attached. If any foreign stream is attached, ABORT and record UNPREPARED rather than capture a mixed stream.
4. Record only paravoxia_finale_window.monitor for a bounded duration.
5. Unload the module in a finally, and verify it is gone.
isolationMechanism.fallbackIfPulseSinkIgnored: pactl move-sink-input <id> paravoxia_finale_window for ONLY the sink-input ids whose application.process.id is in the probe child's process tree. This moves the probe's own stream and nothing else; it is reversible by unloading the sink (streams fall back automatically).

muteAudioFinding.fact: main/tools/lib/previewServer.mjs CHROMIUM_ARGS includes '--mute-audio', and openParavoxia() offers no way to override args.
muteAudioFinding.consequence: Every existing capture in this run, including journey-common-1, ran MUTED at the browser output stage even though the page AudioContext could be 'running'. A live-output recording under the shipped openParavoxia path would record silence and that silence would mean nothing about the game.
muteAudioFinding.resolution: finale-window-probe.mjs --unmuted launches the SAME headed hardware route (chromePath(), headless:false, CHROMIUM_ARGS + --enable-gpu --use-angle=gl, assertHardwareGl) with only '--mute-audio' filtered out. No source file is edited; nothing headless and nothing SwiftShader is used.
